_capture.why_this_and_not_a_live_read: A fixture scraped from an endpoint captures whatever that endpoint happened to be serving. This is the contract's own statement of what it will serve, so a later divergence is falsifiable against something.
_capture.live_cross_check: A read-only GET against the .201 dev lane's projection API returned backing='bus' and rows carrying exactly these fourteen columns. The cross-check agreed; it is not the source.

_nullability_note: The counters are int|None and that distinction is the point of OMN-16777: null marks a window that was never observed (flow_state UNKNOWN), which is a different fact from a window observed to have carried nothing. A renderer that coerces null to 0 reintroduces the exact false-green the projection exists to close.
